services.name: Amazon Prime
steps: Amazon app: tap Account, then Your Prime Membership
Tap Update, cancel and more
Tap Cancel membership and confirm every screen
openIssues: amazon.com help pages still return 503/403 to our tools (curl and WebFetch), so the button names above come only from search snippets of the official help page.

quotes.quote: Hover over the Manage Membership section at the top-right of the screen, then tap the End Membership button.
Scroll down and select Manage Prime Membership. Press on the Manage Membership drop-down menu, and press the Manage Membership button in that menu. Press on the End Membership button.

services.name: ChatGPT
steps: Open chatgpt.com in Safari and sign in
Open your account menu, then Settings → Billing
Under Cancel plan, tap Cancel
openIssues: help.openai.com returns 403 (Cloudflare) to curl and WebFetch, so OpenAI's steps are from search snippets only (article now titled “Canceling your ChatGPT subscription”).

services.answer: Subscribed on the web? Sign in at chatgpt.com, open Settings → Billing and tap Cancel under Cancel plan. Subscribed in the iPhone app? Apple bills you, so cancel in iPhone Settings.
tips: Cancel at least a day before it renews. You keep Plus until the end of the period you paid for.
services.partner: Subscribed in the iPhone app? Apple bills you. Cancel in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

quotes.quote: In Settings, tap your name. Tap Subscriptions. Tap the subscription. Tap Cancel Subscription.

services.name: iCloud+
steps: Open Settings and tap your name
Tap Subscriptions, then iCloud+
Tap Cancel Subscription
services.note: Steps are for iOS 18.4 or later. iOS 18 to 18.3: Settings → your name → iCloud → Manage Plan → Downgrade Options, then pick a new plan. iOS 17 and earlier: iCloud → Manage Account Storage → Downgrade Options. No Apple device: Apple says use reportaproblem.apple.com (support.apple.com/en-us/121290). url set to null: Apple's iCloud+ page gives no web cancel link, and apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions wasn't on any page we read.
services.answer: On your iPhone, open Settings, tap your name, then Subscriptions → iCloud+ → Cancel Subscription. It ends when your current billing period ends.
tips: Using more than the free 5GB? Once it ends, iCloud stops syncing and backups won’t finish. Download or delete what you need first.
On iOS 18.3 or older: Settings → your name → iCloud → Manage Plan (iOS 17: Manage Account Storage) → Downgrade Options, then pick a smaller plan.
services.partner: Pay for Apple One too? It already includes iCloud+ storage, so you can cancel the extra iCloud+ plan and keep using Apple One’s.

quotes.quote: iPhone with iOS 18.4 and later. Open the Settings app, then tap your name. Tap Subscriptions, then tap iCloud+ under Active. To cancel an iCloud+ plan, tap Cancel Subscription.
If you downgrade or cancel your iCloud+ plan, the change takes effect after your current subscription billing period ends.
If your iCloud storage exceeds your new storage plan capacity, iCloud won't sync or update your information, and iCloud backups won't complete.
If you pay for both Apple One and an iCloud+ plan, you can downgrade or cancel the iCloud+ plan and just use the iCloud+ plan included in Apple One.

services.name: Audible
steps: Open audible.com in Safari and sign in
Tap the menu, then your name, then Membership details
Tap Cancel membership, then Confirm cancellation
services.note: help.audible.com/s/article/cancel-membership now 301-redirects to audible.com/help/article/cancel-membership (JS page, read with a headless browser). The url is where that page's “Membership details” link goes. Apple- or Google-billed memberships can't be cancelled on the Audible site. Unused credits are lost at the end, except credits from an App Store or Google Play membership. Pause may be offered to keep credits.
services.answer: Open audible.com in Safari, sign in, then go to your name → Membership details → Cancel membership → Confirm cancellation. Deleting the Audible app doesn’t cancel it.
tips: Spend your credits first. Unused ones are lost when your last billing period ends (credits from an App Store membership don’t expire).
Want to keep your credits? Audible may let you pause instead.
services.partner: Billed by Apple or Google? You can’t cancel on the Audible site. Cancel in iPhone Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

quotes.quote: On mobile web: Select the main menu. Select your name. Select Membership details. Select Cancel membership. Select Confirm cancellation.
Note: Deleting the Audible app will not cancel a membership.
Audible memberships billed through Apple or Google cannot be canceled through the Audible site and must be canceled through the App Store or Google Play Store.
Credits received through an App Store membership or a Google Play Store membership do not expire and will remain in your account after cancellation.

services.name: Paramount+
steps: Open paramountplus.com/account in Safari and sign in
Tap Cancel Subscription
Follow the prompts to the end
services.note: Read on Paramount+'s International Help Center (support.paramountplus.com, updated May 12, 2026), rendered with a headless browser. The US help center (help.paramountplus.com) redirected us to the international one, so US-only wording wasn't seen; the website route is the same paramountplus.com/account page. Apple, Google, Amazon (Fire TV) or Roku billing: cancel there. No refund of fees paid; access runs to the end of the period.
services.answer: Open paramountplus.com/account in Safari, sign in, tap Cancel Subscription and follow the prompts. Signed up through Apple? Cancel in iPhone Settings instead.
tips: You can keep watching until the period you paid for ends. Paramount+ doesn’t refund fees already paid.
services.partner: Billed by Apple, Google, Amazon or Roku? Cancel with them.

quotes.quote: Go to your Paramount+ account page ( paramountplus.com/account ), click the Cancel Subscription link, then follow the online prompts.

On your iPhone or iPad, open the Settings app. Tap your name. Tap Subscriptions. Tap Paramount+. Tap Cancel Subscription. If you don't see Cancel Subscription, the subscription is already canceled and won't renew. Tap Confirm.
Once you have cancelled your subscription, you will still have access to Paramount+ until the cancellation takes effect and you will not be refunded for any fees you have paid.

services.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
steps: Open account.adobe.com/plans in Safari and sign in
Tap Manage plan, then Cancel your plan
Check the details, pick a reason, then tap Confirm cancellation
services.note: Help page last updated Jul 24, 2026. Bought through Apple, Google or Microsoft: cancel there. Annual plan paid monthly: after 14 days, a fee of 50% of the remaining contract (adobe-subscription-terms page). Each plan cancels separately. Can't cancel while a payment is processing or has a problem; wait 24h.
services.answer: Open account.adobe.com/plans in Safari, sign in, tap Manage plan → Cancel your plan, and go through to Confirm cancellation. On an annual plan paid monthly, cancelling after the first 14 days costs 50% of what’s left.
tips: Cancel within 14 days of buying and most plans get a full refund.
Got more than one plan? Each one cancels separately.
Can’t cancel while a payment is processing or has a problem. Wait 24 hours and try again.
services.partner: Bought it through Apple, Google or Microsoft? Cancel with them.

quotes.quote: In the Plans and payment window, select Manage plan for the plan you want to cancel.
Select Cancel your plan.
Check your plan details and then select Continue to cancel. Select the reason for cancellation, and then select Continue. Review the cancellation details and then select Confirm cancellation.
For subscriptions purchased through third-party providers such as Apple, Google, or Microsoft, follow their specific cancellation process.
Note: After 14 days, a cancellation fee (early termination fee) of 50% of the remaining balance of the contract applies.

tips: Your streak and progress stay. Super keeps working until the period you paid for ends.
Signed up on the website? Sign in at duolingo.com, tap your profile picture → Settings → Super Duolingo → Cancel subscription.
services.partner: Subscribed through iPhone Settings instead of the app? Cancel there: Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

quotes.quote: Open the Duolingo app. Tap the Super icon at the top of the home screen. Tap Settings (gear icon). Tap “Manage subscription”. Select “Cancel subscription” and proceed to cancel. Confirm cancellation through Google Play Store or App Store or Alipay
Deleting the app and/or your account does not cancel your subscription.
Your streak and learning progress will not be affected.
